title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 11.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 11.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 allowed authenticated users to read Git LFS objects from projects restricted by External Authorization due to missing authorization checks. The issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions. The CVSS score is low, indicating limited impact.
